label: Visit

copy.headline: Your seat is waiting at Southfield this Saturday
copy.subhead: Join Pastor Curtis and Pastor Tammy at 12 pm, 24301 Telegraph, or tune in online at 8:15 am.
copy.hook: Ever wondered what a real Kingdom gathering feels like?
copy.body: Come as you are. The first Saturday of each month we meet in person at 12 noon—no registration, just a door. If you prefer distance, the Hour of Power streams weekdays at 8:15 am. Choose the place, and let the Lord meet you there.
